description.content:
Endpoint for retrieving data source disclaimer texts. These texts are required to be displayed in user experiences and printed reports when utilising PropTrack data - refer to the [Disclaimers](https://developer.proptrack.com.au/docs/apis/disclaimers) page for an implementation guide. Developers have a choice in the text format to be retrieved - either HTML or Plaintext. Plaintext format utilises \n to indicate a new line. HTML uses minimal markup, to allow integration into your UI as required. > Some disclaimers, such as the Service Agent statement, require dynamic insertion of information such as your company name and ABN.
This will be indicated by square brackets in the text content.

query.description:
(Required) Request for one or more disclaimer types, as a comma-separated list.
This will filter the response to show only the specified disclaimerType(s)

Case insensitive
Only applicable for disclaimerType = `vg`
If omitted, all state VG disclaimers will be returned as an array
If the requested disclaimerType is not `vg` this field will be ignored.

The as-at date enables a requester to retrieve the disclaimer version that was valid at a specific point in time.
This is useful where your implementation is sensitive to text changes, such as a printed PDF, as disclaimer texts are updated from time-to-time.
If as-at date is omitted from the request, the response will provide the current disclaimer version.

Providing an optional text format will enable the requester to control the formatting of the disclaimerContent field on the response.
HTML or Plaintext formatting is supported
